desc.en: Highly viscous soil. This clay can be found in areas where the ocean used to exist, and is often used by historians and archaeologists as a research material.
desc.ja: 粘性の強い土。この粘土が取れる場所にはかつて海があったとされ、歴史学者や考古学者の研究材料になることもしばしば

desc.en: Causes armor to increase maximum HP. Effect: Maximum HP increases by 10.
desc.ja: 防具に最大ＨＰを上昇させる効果を付与する。効果：最大ＨＰが１０上昇する

desc.en: Effect: The item is completely used up in a single use during battle, but its power increases by use count x 2％.
desc.ja: 効果：戦闘中、１回でアイテムを使い切る代わりに、使用回数×２％威力が増加する
